description: Agent plan only. Run sponsor detection on the ENTIRE video history of a YouTuber already in the database (not just the latest videos like youtuber_refresh), and re-check older automatic rejections with the current detection pipeline — use it when youtuber_sponsors looks incomplete for a channel with a long sponsorship history. Costs 200 requests of your monthly MCP quota. Refused when the channel had a full analysis less than 30 days ago (check lastFullAnalysisAt from youtuber_get first). Runs in the background (from several minutes to an hour on big channels); when lastFullAnalysisAt in youtuber_get moves, youtuber_sponsors reflects the result. For a channel not in the database yet, use youtuber_add.
name: youtuber_fullAnalysis
